title: The 10-Year Is The Only Thing Stopping These Breakouts
speaker: Drew Dosik

macro_themes.view: 10-year at ~5.29%, highest since 2002; until it consolidates toward 5%, inverse head-and-shoulders breakouts in stocks will struggle.

calls.condition: Two daily closes back under the neckline (~154.87) would negate the pattern.
calls.reason: Inverse head and shoulders broke its neckline Oct 2 and extended Monday; a pullback to the neckline should act as support for the measured move.
calls.quote: You can see that all the way up here the target is $218.35.

calls.condition: Needs a daily close above $300 to trigger the inverse H&S measured move to $391.50; a close above $305.80 negates the bear flag.
calls.reason: Google $4.3B power deal pumped the stock, attacking the top of a bear flag that also forms an inverse head-and-shoulders neckline.
calls.quote: If we get a daily close above $300, that triggered it that triggers this inverse head and shoulders measured move at $391.50.

calls.condition: Breakout from the neckline targets ~$1,300 (50% of the parallel channel, new ATH); daily closes under $1,035.50 raise odds of a move down.
calls.reason: Messy inverse H&S; neckline repeatedly tested and pierced today, weakening it.
calls.quote: Daily closes underneath this trend line at $1,035.50 actually start increasing probabilities of a move down.

calls.condition: If the breakout continues, inverse H&S measured move to ~$2,625; held back while the 10-year yield stays elevated.
calls.reason: Inverse H&S holding above its neckline after closing under it yesterday.
calls.quote: this inverse head and shoulders pattern has a target and measured move near the top of the parallel at $2,625.02

calls.reason: Overbought at highs not seen since 2002; expects consolidation toward 5% before a monthly breakout toward the 6.249% Fibonacci level.
calls.quote: I still anticipate with this overbought status, we should have some sort of consolidation close down to the 5% level

notes: No weekday stated. Date inferred from the transcript: CEG's Google deal pump was "yesterday" (that news hit 2026-10-06 per other videos) and the SpaceX breakout was "Monday"; listing approx_date 2026-10-08 ("20 hours ago") is likely a day late. SpaceX recorded as SPACEX (existing files use both SPACEX and SPCX). The 5.29%/5.289% figures are as spoken.
